answer: Layered marble bond: each identity locks 60 credits in 3 layers on a marble ledger: entry, work, nectar, 20 each. Filings reach the ocean for replay. A layer warms after one clean epoch of peer-attested work; nectar opens third. 1,000 fakes cost 36+6(k-1) each: 3,033,000 plus 60,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-layer ring fails: the ledger names the warming key; a borrowed layer burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 36 once, keeps its bond.
